classificationRules.PASS: Only the explicitly named executed check succeeded.
classificationRules.FAIL: An executed check confirms a defect or release prerequisite is unsatisfied.
classificationRules.NOT VERIFIED: The required complete acceptance has not run in the applicable environment.

userDeferred: Translations including Haitian Creole human review

phases.name: Backend reconciliation
verifiedSubchecks: Reviewed 35-migration target applies locally. Prior scoped backend package is recorded live.
Both corrected shared CMS handlers are deployed and byte-match source.
Local Auth/PostgREST calls exercise exact product, order, courier, review and CMS signatures.
Three payment migrations and two existing Edge Functions deployed; exact definitions, grants, binding ownership policy and source readback pass. See payment-backend-deployment.json.
remainingAcceptance: All role/contract paths and full production recovery have not been accepted. Existing shared-platform exceptions remain separately documented.

phases.name: Customer screens and controls
verifiedSubchecks: Source registry: 34 customer routes, 1347 extracted bindings, zero unresolved recognized literal registry targets.
Real local purchasing, history visibility, review, cancellation and consumer CMS load paths pass.
remainingAcceptance: Every installed screen/control and 17 computed navigation targets require runtime acceptance.

phases.name: Vendor store/product/builder operations
verifiedSubchecks: Local ownership denial, pending listing, approval, required rejection reason, rejection persistence and fulfillment pass.
Existing builder/restricted-store and product tests pass within their named scopes.
remainingAcceptance: Complete signed-in merchant onboarding, inventory, staff and all operational button scenarios are not manually accepted.

phases.name: Checkout/payment/refund/settlement
verifiedSubchecks: Actual local Wallet pricing, financial tampering denial, retries, refunds and stock preservation pass.
31 native PostgreSQL checks cover sales-cap, withdrawal, settlement, group, Shared Bill, courier and push races.
Original-card refund policy preserved.

12 real Stripe sandbox scenarios pass within 44 local API/recovery scenarios: setup/webhook, authorization, capture, retries, original-card and partial refunds, issuer failure, interruption/reordering, and dispute recovery.
Existing test-mode webhook event subscriptions now include all 12 handled events, preserving its URL, API version, prior event and signing secret. Delivery/key alignment remains unverified.
remainingAcceptance: Installed card entry/3DS challenge and deployed webhook/key/account configuration remain unverified. Sandbox server tests are not full live-provider acceptance.

phases.name: Courier and delivery
verifiedSubchecks: Assigned-courier API access, wrong-courier denial, GPS authorization, pickup/completion and 24-hour hold pass locally.
Real local private Storage upload, MIME restrictions, consumer signed resolver, authorized exact-byte reads, wrong-account denials, post-delivery immutability and customer receipt confirmation pass.
Native Android development compilation and signature verification pass.
remainingAcceptance: Physical GPS/background/offline/maps, hosted private Storage/camera and push behavior are not verified.

phases.name: Group orders and Shared Bill
verifiedSubchecks: Local 60/40 and full-payment contributions, original-customer ownership, idempotency and per-payer refunds pass through Auth/PostgREST.
Native PostgreSQL group/Shared Bill race tests pass.
remainingAcceptance: Complete installed invitation/QR/offline/restart interactions and release-gate activation acceptance remain open; no production gate was activated.

phases.name: Admin operations
verifiedSubchecks: 71 admin tests and the paired admin CI pass.
Real local moderation, restricted-staff denial, orders oversight, reviews and CMS permission checks pass.
remainingAcceptance: All signed-in admin modules, restricted roles and every operational control are not manually accepted.

phases.name: CMS coverage/preview/publication
verifiedSubchecks: 1926 registered fields in 73 groups across 34 registered customer routes.
Real local draft permissions, draft isolation, protected fees and publication to actual consumer module pass; 2102 candidate labels roundtrip.

remainingAcceptance: Every editable field has not been manually previewed/published/reloaded on an installed app. Native cache/realtime acceptance remains open.

phases.name: Notifications/messaging/security

Existing push worker/device/outbox/session/retry tests pass; production activation unchanged.
Leaked-password protection is explicitly excluded by the owner until a future Pro upgrade; it is not an active acceptance requirement.
Real private Storage HTTP denies unrelated users, anonymous access and restricted staff; public evidence URLs stay unavailable.
Direct Stripe customer binding and saved-card writes are denied to clients. Actual signed sandbox webhook duplicates, invalid signatures, authorization failures and financial retries pass.

Preflight now refuses real Stripe test accounts with any enabled Dashboard webhook before financial object creation; four regression tests and the actual read-only refusal pass. Prior automatic hosted event receipts are disclosed, retained and checked for synthetic financial records (none found).
remainingAcceptance: Physical push/provider behavior and every notification/message destination are not verified.
Leaked-password protection remains disabled but is deferred by the owner until a future Pro upgrade.

verifiedSubchecks: No UI redesign or production demo flow added; safe CMS errors and existing cleanup retained.
Configured zh-Hans request validation repaired without publishing content.

Source cleanup is verified within its recorded checks; full installed-screen acceptance remains open.

phases.name: Automated tests and builds
verifiedSubchecks: 501 core tests (282 customer) with zero skipped; 31 native PostgreSQL checks; 35 actual local API/Storage/recovery scenarios; 44 local API/recovery scenarios including 12 real Stripe sandbox cases; current CI, TypeScript, lint and exports pass. Counts overlap only where explicitly stated. Android development compilation/signature and anonymous browser startup pass.

Initial private iOS build exposed Stripe SPM static-linkage failure. The documented dynamic-framework fix passes actual generated configuration, 282 customer regressions, TypeScript and lint; the private iOS simulator build now compiles successfully; downloaded universal arm64/x86_64 artifact identity is verified.
Latest Android ARM64 development compilation and apksigner checks pass at the same source commit. No app release or production signing.
remainingAcceptance: Production Android/iOS signing, installed-screen acceptance, native card/3DS and physical-device requirements remain open.

phases.name: Production release decision
verifiedSubchecks: No Wantiss app release, live-mode charge, production financial mutation, hosted test branch or CMS publication. Prior automatic test-event forwarding is disclosed and guarded against.
remainingAcceptance: Owner-deferred content/Auth remain excluded. Full installed application/device, deployed provider configuration and actual production-backup acceptance still require evidence.
